description: MoinPDF uses LibreOfficeKit for one-shot conversion without also starting the soffice desktop application. Honor verbose=false, as the upstream Node converter does. Original corresponding source remains in MATBEE-SOURCES; these exact replacements are applied by scripts/prepare-office-assets.mjs.

replacements.description: PDF export does not use image page/part metadata. Match the upstream Node converter's direct load/save path and query editor parts only for actual image exports.

Start only LibreOfficeKit. Configure the synchronous conversion path before Emscripten constructs and caches the native environment: avoid nested background image import/scaling and formula-calculation tasks that can block the WASM runtime thread.
Honor the supplied verbose flag for LibreOffice stdout and stderr; no synthetic document contents are written to the browser console in normal use.
Keep warnings enabled without forcing all LibreOffice diagnostic categories.
Keep the diagnostic label consistent with the changed setting.
The pinned Emscripten build exposes PThread on the worker global, not Module. Destroy that pool explicitly, also while asynchronous initialization has not yet assigned E.
Pure load/save conversion does not post editor input events. Leave the regular LibreOfficeKit yield path enabled.
replacements.before: c.enableSyncEvents(),console.log("[LOK Worker] Enabled synchronous event dispatch (Unipoll mode)"),

replacements.description: Do not enter synchronous LibreOfficeKit calls until all initial pthread workers have acknowledged their compiled module. Record the readiness barrier for the real-browser regression test.
replacements.after: {let p=self.PThread,w=[...p.unusedWorkers,...p.runningWorkers],t=Date.now();while(w.some(a=>!a.loaded)){if(Date.now()-t>10000)throw new Error("Office pthread initialization timeout");await new Promise(a=>setTimeout(a,10));}y({type:"progress",id:ge,progress:{phase:"thread-pool",percent:68,workers:w.length,readyWorkers:w.filter(a=>a.loaded).length}});}B("lok-init","Initializing LibreOfficeKit...");

replacements.description: The conversion owner is a Web Worker that also services synchronous pthread proxy requests. Native Atomics.wait can deadlock that owner while a pthread needs its filesystem or another proxied operation. Select Emscripten 3.1.74 main-thread cooperative futex waiting for this sole runtime owner (main-browser flag=1, supports-Atomics.wait=0); its _emscripten_yield loop services the proxy queue. Real pthread initialization is unchanged. The page UI still runs in its separate main thread. Source: system/lib/pthread/emscripten_futex_wait.c.
